_comment: The project's PUBLIC identity, in one place. Every package, the site and the About box read it; nothing else may name the maintainer or a way to reach him (tools/build-tests/identity.tests.ps1 fails on a personal address or profile anywhere a build reads). Committed on purpose: packages are built on other machines from the sources. Free Fit has no mailbox - questions and reports go to the issue tracker; maintainerAddress is GitHub's no-reply address, which Debian's Maintainer field needs and which delivers nowhere. A module with a product of its own brings its own identity.
